text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali received visiting French Foreign Affairs Minister Hubert Vedrine and discussed with him bilaterlal relations, the Middle East peace process and international issues.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari met his visiting French counterpart Hubert Vedrine on economic and financial cooperation between the two countries.
- Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri said Tunisia had an output of 315,000 tonnes of potatoes in 1996, or 15 tonnes per hectare.
- Visiting French Foreign Minister Hubert Vedrine told a news conference, that France deplored the deadlock in the Middle East peace process.
- Estimated production of dates for the southern region of Kebili is put at 42,000 tonnes this year. Kebili represents 65 percent of Tunisia's production.
